title: Dipolog City Marathon 2026 Review: Zamboanga's Sunset Boulevard Full Marathon
seo_title: Dipolog City Marathon 2026 Review | Zamboanga Philippines
meta_description: The Dipolog City Marathon 2026: October 4 at Sunset Boulevard, Dipolog. Full marathon to 5K from the city LGU — a Zamboanga peninsula road race reviewed.
dek: Set for 4 October 2026 at Sunset Boulevard in Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte, this LGU-organised marathon offers four distances. A local-government-backed full marathon on Mindanao's northwestern coast.
verdict: The Dipolog City Marathon is a local-government-organised full marathon on the Sunset Boulevard of Dipolog — the capital of Zamboanga del Norte on Mindanao's northwestern coast. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) backed by the city LGU. Dipolog is known for its sardine industry, its Spanish-era cathedral, and Dakak Beach Resort nearby. October in Zamboanga is relatively dry by Mindanao standards. For runners wanting a provincial Philippine marathon with government backing and a coastal boulevard course, this is one to track.

sections.heading: Dipolog: Zamboanga's Coastal Capital
paragraphs: Dipolog City sits on the northwestern coast of Mindanao, known for its Sunset Boulevard — a waterfront stretch popular with local runners — and its proximity to Dakak Beach Resort. [1] The city LGU's involvement gives the race government backing and institutional resources.
